figId.description: Archive figure id <waveId>::<figureName>; must resolve in data/figures.json

high.description: High end of the reported band in USD

kind.description: sold-band: reported sold range; sold-avg: reported average over tracked sales; listing: a listing price, not a sale; claimed: unverified claimed price

label.description: Short human label, e.g. which deco the band covers

low.description: Low end of the reported band in USD

note.description: Honest context: what the band covers, single-source flags

singleSource.description: True when the price rests on one unverified source

source.description: Named source of the reported price

sourceUrl.description: URL for the source: external tracker URL or a relative Chronicle page
